blocks.en: Let $L(D)$ be a differential operator with constant coefficients. Then a \textbf{fundamental solution} for $L$ is a distribution $G\in\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(\mathbb{R}^m)$ satisfying the equation $L(D)G=\delta$.
blocks.zh: 设 $L(D)$ 为常系数微分算子. 那么 $L$ 的\textbf{基本解}是满足方程 $L(D)G=\delta$ 的分布 $G\in\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(\mathbb{R}^m)$.
